aboutHeroDescription: We're on a mission to eliminate the tedious hours property managers spend on manual financial reporting, so they can focus on what matters most—growing their business.
aboutMissionP1: Property managers spend 2-4 hours every month manually compiling financial reports for each client. That's time taken away from managing properties, growing portfolios, and serving clients better.
aboutMissionP2: TheSmartHost automates this entire workflow. Our PMS-agnostic platform accepts exports from any booking platform and transforms raw data into professional, branded reports in minutes—not hours.
aboutProblemSubtitle: Manual reporting is holding property managers back from scaling
aboutProblem1: Dual-screen data entry across multiple platforms
aboutProblem2: Manual fee calculations with high error risk
aboutProblem3: Inconsistent report formats for different clients
aboutProblem4: Delayed reporting cycles affecting cash flow
aboutProblem5: Growth limitations due to time constraints
aboutSolution1: Single CSV upload for all booking data
aboutSolution3: Standardized branded PDF reports every time
aboutSolution4: Real-time dashboard with instant report generation

contactFaq2A: We currently support Hostaway, Airbnb, and VRBO exports. More integrations are coming soon.

contactFaq3A: Yes! Our platform supports unlimited properties and clients with batch import capabilities.

productHeroDescription: PMS-agnostic owner reporting that transforms hours of manual work into minutes of automated precision.
productCoreCapabilitiesSubtitle: Everything you need to automate your property management reporting workflow
productUnifiedCsvDesc: Single upload interface accepts exports from Hostaway, Airbnb, VRBO with automatic field mapping and validation.
productFinancialEngineDesc: Automated computation of Stripe fees, platform taxes, and management fees using configurable formulas.
productDashboardDesc: Real-time view of bookings, revenue, and fees with drill-down capability and responsive design.
productReportGenDesc: One-click PDF creation with branded templates, standardized format, and professional presentation.
productMultiTenantDesc: Secure client portal where property owners can access monthly reports for their properties 24/7.
productSecurityDesc: Row-level security, data isolation, audit trails, and secure file storage for financial data protection.
productExploreFeaturesSubtitle: Click to learn more about each capability
productSmartCsvDesc: Our intelligent upload wizard automatically detects your PMS platform, maps fields correctly, and validates data before import. No manual configuration needed.
productAutoCalcDesc: Say goodbye to spreadsheet errors. Our calculation engine handles all fee computations with configurable formulas that match your exact business logic.
productRealtimeDashboardDesc: Interactive analytics that let you drill down into every booking, every property, every client. See the full picture of your business performance.
productProfessionalReportsDesc: Generate beautifully formatted PDF reports with your branding in one click. Consistent, professional, and ready to share with clients.
productHowItWorksSubtitle: From raw data to professional reports in four simple steps
productStep1Desc: Export your bookings from any PMS and drop the CSV into TheSmartHost. Our system automatically identifies the format and maps the data.
productStep2Desc: Watch as the system calculates all fees, taxes, and commissions in seconds. No manual entry, no spreadsheet formulas to maintain.
productStep3Desc: Check everything in the interactive dashboard. Drill down into any booking or property to verify the numbers before finalizing.
productStep4Desc: One click creates professional, branded PDF reports for each client. Send directly or let them access through the client portal.
